name: Luosiding
source:
The year 31xx.

As technology advances rapidly, human work and daily life are swept along in its wake.

City boundaries define the scope of human existence, enclosing those accepted into the urban fold.

Within the city, survival depends on the corporations.

You're an intern awaiting your full-time employment review this Friday—but your project team has just been disbanded...

As luck would have it...

A gentle supervisor, a cool-headed colleague, and a lively AI have all invited you to join them.

Which will you accept?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4864590/Screw/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
31xx年。

随着科技飞速迭代，人类的工作与日常生活也在这股浪潮裹挟下一路向前。

城市的边界划定了人类生存的版图，将获准融入都市体系的人们圈护其中。

而在高墙之内，能否活下去全仰仗各大企业。

你是一名等待本周五转正考核的实习生——可你所在的项目组偏偏刚刚宣告解散……

万幸的是……

温柔体贴的上司、沉着冷静的同事，还有活泼灵动的AI，不约而同地向你递出了橄榄枝。

你会接受哪一方的邀请？

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4864590/Screw/]Steam[/url]]
